findings.finding: CONFIRMED FIXED: round-1 violation 1 (linked-worktree refusal). resolvePrimaryRoot no longer uses --show-toplevel; it runs git rev-parse --git-common-dir, absolutizes, then filepath.Dir to the directory that contains .git. runFeatureStatus, runDefectRecord, runDefectList, and runDefectDecline no longer call IsLinkedWorktree. Mutating verbs still refuse, but they now check gitShowToplevel (the current checkout) rather than the newly-resolved primary root — necessary, because IsLinkedWorktree(primaryRoot) would never fire once primaryRoot is the main working tree. Empirically, from this lane's own linked worktree, --git-common-dir returns /home/lanzerdev/git_root/lucind-ai/.git and Dir yields /home/lanzerdev/git_root/lucind-ai, so ledger.Open lands on the primary lucind.db, not a worktree-local copy. That is the intended single-ledger location, not a wrong-ledger write.
